scope: canonical shrine place sheets (not independent Calendar artwork or general asset bank)
method: Checked the canonical shrine data schema and the source-owned Explore Place renderer. Shrine-to-photo mappings, visual attribution and rights records are not published by this module. This does not imply suitable photographs do not exist elsewhere.

guardrails: Do not scrape and republish an official website photograph without permission or a compatible license.
Do not substitute Calendar saint paintings for an unrelated physical shrine photograph.
Do not equate map pin accuracy with photo subject accuracy.
Keep place cards useful without photographs until validated images are available.
